Implementation Plan

Planning ref: `orchestrator/project-2627` @ `a5ed4731e7a9065585c869a9174c20eddad662a7`

Clarification mapping
- No `Q1`/`Q2` questions were asked in clarify, so `/answer [auto-answered-by-orchestrator]` just means the issue was already specific enough to plan.

## 1. Files likely to change
- `tests/test_review_pipeline_integration.py` — add the one dedicated integration-style pytest here (preferred: reuse the existing review-chain integration file instead of spreading the work across more test modules).
- `README.md` — append review-autofix rollout docs under existing review-artifact / flag sections.
- `agents.md` — append missing stable log prefixes in the existing “Stable log prefixes (contractual)” section and add the `.ai/review_runtime/` persistence contract in the existing review-pipeline contract section.
- `docs/plans/judge-loop-and-reissue-plan.md` — delete last, after the permanent docs/test coverage are in place.
- No workflow or script logic changes should be needed for this issue.

## 2. Functions / modules to implement
- Use `tests/test_review_pipeline_integration.py::test_chain_happy_path_with_mocked_consolidator` as the chaining pattern.
- Add one end-to-end pytest that shells the landed scripts against a temp repo with mocked binaries:
  - round 1: run `scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh` to produce `.ai/review_runtime/pr-4242/round-1/judge_interim.json`;
  - run `scripts/review_reject_verify.sh` with typed rejection schema/verifier enabled and mocked `codex`/`timeout` so `.ai/review_runtime/.../verified_rejections.json` is written;
  - run `scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh` against the round-1 judge artifact so the synth manifest/wrappers land under `.ai/review_runtime/.../synth/`;
  - round 2: run `scripts/review_annotate_sticky.sh` (and, if needed, `review_reject_verify.sh` again) so the prior-round rejection is re-supported via sticky matching and the sticky priors are emitted.
- For the `close_and_reissue` / `spot-fix` baseline case, reuse the existing harness patterns from:
  - `tests/test_review_rb_judge_label_propagation.py::_run_close_and_reissue`
  - `tests/test_review_rb_judge_reissue_baseline.py::test_resolver_accepts_real_spot_fix_issue_body_from_review_blocked_judge`
- The test should prove producer/consumer alignment between `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh` and the implement-side `Resolve trusted prior PR baseline branch` step in `.github/workflows/implement.yml`.

## 3. Data structures affected
- `.ai/review_runtime/pr-<PR>/round-<N>/judge_interim.json`
- `.ai/review_runtime/pr-<PR>/round-<N>/verified_rejections.json`
- `.ai/review_runtime/pr-<PR>/round-<N>/sticky_findings.json`
- `.ai/review_runtime/pr-<PR>/round-<N>/consolidator_parsed.txt` and sticky priors text
- `.ai/review_runtime/pr-<PR>/round-<N>/synth/synth_round_<N>_manifest.json` plus cached wrapper scripts
- Review-blocked reissue footer fields: `prior_pr_baseline_branch` and `files_touched`
- Documentation contracts only; no runtime defaults or identifiers should change.

## 4. API / interface changes
- No production behavior change is planned.
- `README.md` should document the already-landed opt-in flags as still default-off, at minimum:
  - `CONSOLIDATOR_REJECT_SCHEMA_ENABLED=false`
  - `CONSOLIDATOR_REJECT_VERIFIER_ENABLED=false`
  - `STICKY_FINDINGS_ENABLED=false`
  - `JUDGE_INTERIM_ENABLED=false`
  - `BEHAVIOURAL_SMOKE_FROM_JUDGE_ENABLED=false`
  - `REISSUE_PRESERVE_BASELINE_ENABLED=false`
- Companion knobs (`*_REASONING`, `*_TIMEOUT_S`, `STICKY_LINE_BUCKET`, `CONSOLIDATOR_REJECT_VERIFIER_BATCH_MAX`, etc.) should be documented as secondary tuning only when the parent gate is enabled.
- `agents.md` should append the missing sticky log-prefix contract(s) emitted by `scripts/review_annotate_sticky.sh`, plus the `.ai/review_runtime/` persistence/cache contract.

## 5. Risks / edge cases
- The planning context does not show an explicit `files_touched` footer, so the safe assumption is: keep edits to the integration-test file, `README.md`, `agents.md`, and the plan doc only.
- `README.md` has multiple review-autofix doc surfaces; avoid contradictory defaults and do not imply a default-true rollout.
- `agents.md` already documents reject/smoke/judge/reissue prefixes; append only the missing sticky additions rather than reshuffling the section.
- The new pytest must genuinely cover two rounds and cross-round reuse under `.ai/review_runtime/`, not just isolated unit behaviors.
- Delete `docs/plans/judge-loop-and-reissue-plan.md` only after docs/test updates are complete.
- Do not recreate `docs/judge-loop-and-reissue-improvements.md` (it is already absent on this ref).

## 6. Testing considerations
- Run the new integration pytest directly and verify it covers:
  - round-1 judge interim artifact creation,
  - typed rejection verifier artifact creation,
  - round-2 sticky promotion / prior-round rejection support,
  - behavioural smoke manifest/wrapper synthesis,
  - `close_and_reissue` + `spot-fix` baseline metadata accepted by the implement-side resolver.
- If any nearby helper assertions are touched, rerun the focused baseline/reject-verifier suites that already pin those contracts.
- Confirm the docs edits keep every new `*_ENABLED` flag defaulting to `false` in prose.

Assumptions
- No clarification was required.
- This is a docs/tests cleanup issue only; no workflow/script runtime logic changes are needed.

Missing-context notes
- `files_touched` is not explicitly shown in the planning context; I assumed the intended touch set is the one integration test file plus `README.md`, `agents.md`, and the plan file.

Conflicts / repo-state notes
- Branch metadata matches the checked-out ref; no integration-branch mismatch blocker.
- `README.md` currently does not document the new judge-loop/reissue opt-in flags.
- `agents.md` currently documents reject/smoke/judge/reissue prefixes but not the sticky additions, and it does not yet describe the `.ai/review_runtime/` persistence contract.
- `docs/plans/judge-loop-and-reissue-plan.md` still exists and needs removal; `docs/judge-loop-and-reissue-improvements.md` is already absent.
